# occupied

The person made things of their own under the names the sync wants: a skill
directory `rgd-contract-skill` in `~/.agents/skills`, another one named
`rgd-contract-command` (the name a workflow gets when it arrives as a skill,
since Codex has no slash commands) and an MCP server
`[mcp_servers.rgd-contract-stdio]` in `config.toml`. The manifest does not
list them, so they are the person's, and the sync reports the names as taken
instead of overwriting them. The other server is still delivered.
